## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
DD4 (pre-implementation): RED tests for fail-loud config validation

## TDD
- Given: CI_REVIEW_PROVIDER=anthropic env OR ci_review.provider=openai in config
- When: get_provider() called with env and config in various combinations
- Then: env wins over config; missing provider raises ConfigError; missing API key raises AuthError

Tests in tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_providers_config.py:
1. test_env_var_wins_over_config: CI_REVIEW_PROVIDER=anthropic + config openai → returns AnthropicProvider
2. test_missing_provider_raises_config_error: no env, no config → ConfigError
3. test_unknown_provider_raises_config_error: provider="gemini" (not implemented) → ConfigError
4. test_missing_api_key_raises_auth_error: provider=openai, OPENAI_API_KEY absent → AuthError
5. test_valid_config_returns_provider: normal setup → returns correct provider type

.test-index: RED marker [test_env_var_wins_over_config] for providers/config.py

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh completes (RED marker exempts config tests)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] test_providers_config.py exists with test functions
  Verify: test -f tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_providers_config.py && grep -c "def test_" tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_providers_config.py | awk '{exit ($1<3)}'
- [ ] .test-index has RED marker for config.py
  Verify: grep '\[test_env_var_wins_over_config\]' .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
